evidence: V5 triggers component failure only when no complete finite bootstrap replicate can be formed and family failure only when no member has a complete finite replicate.

The adjudication requires the entire registered bootstrap slack/deviation array for a point-eligible component to be complete and finite, and separately requires family NOT_ESTIMABLE whenever any required M_b is a maximum over an empty estimable set.
V5 does prohibit skipping/redrawing/imputation but does not assign an unambiguous status to the two intermediate cases above.

Keep T4 ZERO_ADDED_BOOTSTRAP as the sole post-point-denominator numerical exception and keep the finite constant-array scale floor unchanged.
